summary: The recorded base has all five issue-reported discarded create_task results. The exact candidate retains each task until completion and removes completed, failed, or cancelled tasks from its owner set. Candidate regressions and independent lifecycle/adversarial checks passed against checkout source.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before AST assertion detected the first discarded create_task result at mesh_api.py:222; a complete base scan separately recorded all five issue-named sites.
10 candidate and existing unit tests passed, covering reported-site static ownership, manager and mesh retention/cleanup, and multi-tokenizer behavior.
No discarded create_task expression remained in the three reported files; concurrent, successful, failed, and cancelled manager tasks and cancelled mesh tasks had correct ownership cleanup.
Candidate patch has no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: The original issue is an environment-independent Python asyncio task-ownership defect requiring neither GPU execution nor model weights.

remaining_limitations: No GPU/model serving, model-semantic, performance, or distributed-runtime behavior was tested because it is outside the original static asyncio ownership contract.
No native rebuild was performed because the candidate changes no native source.
The host emitted an unrelated NUMA-balancing warning during aiter import.
